# Regimen

> Regimen is an all-in-one fitness planning app for people who lift weights. It builds a weekly workout schedule, calculates calorie and macro targets (protein is set to 1 gram per pound of body weight), plans meals with exact gram portions, and gives an exact weight and rep target for every exercise in the next session. It runs in any web browser at {{SITE}}/app/ ; iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. Prices are in Canadian dollars.

## What it does
- Workout schedule: places workouts on the user's chosen training days in rotation order. Users can move, skip, pause, undo, or reset. Moving a workout shifts later ones only as far as needed. Ready-made upper/lower plans for 4 or 5 days, or custom plans.
- Guided workouts: set logging, rest timer, pause/resume, exercise substitution.
- Progression: double progression or linear progression gives an exact next-session weight and rep target per exercise, using the user's available weight increments.
- Calories and macros: Mifflin-St Jeor equation × activity level, adjusted for goal (fat loss, muscle gain, recomposition, strength, maintenance). Protein = 1 g per lb of body weight. Optional separate training-day and rest-day targets. All targets editable.
- Meal planner: splits daily macros across meals and calculates grams of each chosen food to hit them; cooked and raw weights; food substitutions matched on protein, carbs or fat.
- Meal prep calculator and automatic grocery list grouped by aisle.
- Food data: USDA FoodData Central search and barcode lookup (Open Food Facts); custom foods and recipes.
- Progress: weekly check-ins, body measurements, private progress photos, personal records, analytics (weight trend, training volume, strength, macro adherence).
- Calendar sync: private live subscription link for Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar.
- Guided setup takes about 2 minutes; an in-app tour explains each screen.

## Pricing (CAD)
- Free: guided setup, calculated calorie and macro targets, preview of the training week, weight logging, dashboard.
- Regimen Pro: CA$179.99 per year (about CA$15/month, recommended) or CA$24.99 per month. 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime; access continues to the end of the paid period and data is kept.

## Privacy
- Account data and photos are stored in Canada (Supabase, Canada Central region). Photos are private to the user.
- No ads, data is not sold, not used to train AI models.

## Important
- Regimen provides planning estimates, not medical advice.
